g.text: Test-set correct trials of the 8 patients with a channel in any of these parcels. Signed new-vs-seen SHAP (> 0 helps the correct call), summed over the parcels' features, missing features left out.

g.text: Split violins: new (left) and seen (recent + old, right) trials, short lines = medians; y range ±0.408 (99th percentile of |value|). Dots: patients' balanced means (new, recent, old 1/2, 1/4, 1/4).
